intent_record.intent_summary: Correct the bit field mask definitions in the generic command register to match the actual hardware specification and add support for the previously undocumented GENERIC_PARAMS field.
intent_record.what: Updated bit field masks in reg_generic_cmd_fmask array: GENERIC_CHID changed from GENMASK(9, 5) to GENMASK(12, 5), GENERIC_EE changed from GENMASK(13, 10) to GENMASK(16, 13), updated reserved bits comment from 'Bits 14-31' to 'Bits 17-23', and added new GENERIC_PARAMS field with GENMASK(31, 24).
intent_record.how: This change expands the bit field definitions to match the actual hardware register layout. GENERIC_CHID now uses 8 bits instead of 5, GENERIC_EE now uses 4 bits instead of 4 (but shifted higher), and introduces a new GENERIC_PARAMS field occupying the upper 8 bits. This allows the driver to correctly interpret and manipulate these fields when reading/writing the GENERIC_CMD register.
